test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 12 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.

Many people love to visit __enchanting__ hills.
solution:
The correct answer is '**alluring**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**alluring**" means powerfully and mysteriously attractive or fascinating. (मोहक)
 
• The hills are described as enchanting, which means charming or delightful, similar to alluring.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Many people love to visit alluring__ hills.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Cool (शांत)**: means moderately cold; not fitting the context of enchanting.
 
• **Risky (जोखिम भरा)**: means involving risk or danger; not fitting the context.
 
• **Echoing (प्रतिध्वनि)**: means a sound repeating; not fitting the context of enchanting.
